description: This file defines an abstract class 'TimesheetPeriod' within the OrangeHRM system, specifically in the TimeSheetPeriod namespace. It declares two abstract methods related to managing timesheet periods, serving as a base class for concrete implementations.

classes.name: TimesheetPeriod
classes.description: An abstract base class for handling timesheet periods in the OrangeHRM TimeSheetPeriod module. It defines methods for setting the period and calculating days within the period, meant to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: setTimesheetPeriodAndStartDate
methods.description: Abstract method to set the timesheet period and start date, accepting a start day as a string.

methods.name: calculateDaysInTheTimesheetPeriod
methods.description: Abstract method to calculate days within the timesheet period given the current date and XML data.
